name: Helia Court
description: Multi-agent forecasting court for prediction-market questions with evidence witnesses, counsel, verdicts, receipts, Arc escrow settlement, Telegram alerts, and x402 paid proof APIs.

skills.name: Queue Forecasting Hearing
skills.description: Queues a long-running multi-agent hearing for a prediction-market, macro, crypto-market, or real-world-event question.
examples: Will this Polymarket question resolve yes?
Run a source-quality forecast hearing for this Kalshi market URL.

skills.name: Prediction Market Analysis
skills.description: Reads supported Polymarket, Kalshi, and Manifold questions and prepares market context for courtroom review.
examples: Analyze this Polymarket URL before the hearing.
Summarize the Kalshi market context and resolution criteria.

skills.name: Evidence Research
skills.description: Collects source trails, freshness notes, web evidence, and uncertainty signals for a case record.
examples: Gather evidence for both sides of this market.
Find source-quality notes for this claim.

skills.name: Verdict Record
skills.description: Returns hearing status, transcript pointers, verdict payloads, confidence, rationale, and receipt references for queued jobs.
examples: Get the result for hearing job abc123.
Return the verdict and receipt trail for this queued case.
